title: Schema change held pending a primary decision

source.note: The implementation choice is explicitly handed to “the primary,” and the subsequent context shows a primary decision. This is an agent-to-coordinator handback, not a current request for end-user input.

evidence.user_prompt_tail:
rts only b and writes b.T, which names a.T.
The current query would miss these sites and still report a complete inventory, which is a false absence.
Rule to implement: an unexported target (Go spec 'Exported identifiers': not starting with an uppercase letter; read it from the declaration's structured name, not from source text) is visible only inside its own package, so keep same-package candidates only. An exported target uses the reverse TRANSITIVE import closure of its package (recursive CTE over go_package_imports using idx_go_package_imports_target), plus same package, within the selected context, with the per-blob lookup-identity index filtering by spelling as today. External test packages and transient placements participate as now. Add regression tests for the method-through-intermediate-package, promoted-member, and alias-re-export cases (compiler-check each fixture with `go build` in /tmp), and a populated query-plan check for the recursive CTE. Then finish the validation from my previous message.
